rv.q: THE STRANGE CASE OF DR. JEKYLL AND MR. HYDE is a mystery to be experienced.
The malevolent glee with which Sharkey imbues Hyde is delicious in the ripe Vincent Price/Christopher Lee tradition.

I found the seduction scenes unconvincing, but intimacy designers Samantha Kaufman (sh/h) and Courtney Abbott (sh/h) had quite a challenge with Hyde’s despoilment of Jekyll – though I did love Hyde’s line, “Just think of it as masturbation.”
Michael Dalberg’s quick-witted and crafty adaptation of “The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde” is diabolically delicious.

cn.t: This adaptation earns praise for its crafty reimagining and dark entertainment value, though reactions range from "diabolically delicious" to merely "weird," with critics agreeing it's fitting Halloween fare.
